title: Live means a price frame arrived; heartbeats never count (row 7 match line, ours stricter)
reference_behaviour: The watchdog counts any packet, pings included, as a sign of life.
ours: A quote is live only on price frames, never heartbeats (REQ-049 AC-2); kept as stricter safety under ADR-015 (no stale price shown as live). Connection silence stays per REQ-114 AC-1.
